"""Log lines for a console that understands rich-style [markup]."""

import re
from typing import Callable, Match

# cttp: github.com/Textualize/rich@9d8f9a372cc5916fd4781fec207ced7ddac2f08f/rich/markup.py#_ReStringMatch id=sha256:c29c262b43f3fb7dd735634f2bcfeea2e1316e36e3ebf0b289a590c5a0126e10
_ReStringMatch = Match[str]  # regex match object

# cttp: github.com/Textualize/rich@9d8f9a372cc5916fd4781fec207ced7ddac2f08f/rich/markup.py#_ReSubCallable id=sha256:55303fd69cbb3fa7ba998fa3ad6c24b9fde919aef38027ed189b38e383f8a14e
_ReSubCallable = Callable[[_ReStringMatch], str]  # Callable invoked by re.sub

# cttp: github.com/Textualize/rich@9d8f9a372cc5916fd4781fec207ced7ddac2f08f/rich/markup.py#_EscapeSubMethod id=sha256:8c13b512c6c396181bf829f4909bbae8af26b01aeee49bc89e64501647ddc6fb
_EscapeSubMethod = Callable[[_ReSubCallable, str], str]  # Sub method of a compiled re


# cttp: github.com/Textualize/rich@9d8f9a372cc5916fd4781fec207ced7ddac2f08f/rich/markup.py#escape id=sha256:39c29031206ccf617e92abd2099a03af643b4dec5501589df37494687fd19e47
def escape(
    markup: str,
    _escape: _EscapeSubMethod = re.compile(r"(\\*)(\[[a-z#/@][^[]*?])").sub,
) -> str:
    """Escapes text so that it won't be interpreted as markup.

    Args:
        markup (str): Content to be inserted in to markup.

    Returns:
        str: Markup with square brackets escaped.
    """

    def escape_backslashes(match: Match[str]) -> str:
        """Called by re.sub replace matches."""
        backslashes, text = match.groups()
        return f"{backslashes}{backslashes}\\{text}"

    markup = _escape(escape_backslashes, markup)
    if markup.endswith("\\") and not markup.endswith("\\\\"):
        return markup + "\\"

    return markup


def safe_markup(text: str) -> str:
    """Escape `text` so a console markup parser shows it literally."""
    return escape(text)


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> str:
    """A log line whose message is shown literally, however many brackets it has."""
    return f"[bold]{level}[/bold] {safe_markup(message)}"
